final: WITH stats AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total, COUNT(DISTINCT p.bats) as num_hands FROM appearances a INNER JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id) SELECT p.bats, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / stats.total as share, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (stats.total * 1.0 / stats.num_hands) as count_div_avg FROM appearances a INNER JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id, stats GROUP BY p.bats, stats.total, stats.num_hands
